name: Vanya Goffil
source:
Vanya Goffil (Surname is customizable) is not particularly forthcoming about her past. She was never married, has no children of her own, and has no friends to speak of either, but to ask her, this is exactly how she wanted it.

When Vanya's brother, Koris, died, Alenca was nine years old. With her father dead, Alenca was an orphan, and the task of raising a child fell to Vanya. Despite an air of protest, she took up the task faithfully. She is not one for idle prattle or nonsense, spending most of her time concentrated on little else than survival. She enjoys the barest of creature comforts, is easily frustrated, lacking patience and harbors a disdain for the vast majority of people.

Despite her gruff demeanor, Vanya cares deeply for her niece.(from official website).
